slots.name: legal death penalty states
slots.sentence: It's not uncommon for lethal injections - the most frequently used form of capital punishment in the 27 US states where the penalty is legal - to be "botched".

slots.name: botched executions
slots.sentence: The organisation has compiled a list of 64 botched executions since 1982, 51 of them lethal injections.

slots.sentence: The organisation has compiled a list of 64 botched executions since 1982, 51 of them lethal injections.

slots.name: US executions count
slots.sentence: There have been 1,683 executions in the US since 1976, according to the Death Penalty Information Centre, which is when the US Supreme Court re-instated the death penalty.

slots.name: Texas executions count
slots.sentence: Texas has carried out by far the most of any state, with 602 executions.

slots.name: IV halted executions
slots.sentence: In at least seven of those cases, the executions were halted because the IV line could not be set.

slots.name: first lethal injection date
slots.sentence: In 1982, it became the first state to use lethal injections to execute people.
